name: Ho Chi Minh Square
kicker: The open square and the 18 m statue
summary: Walk Quảng trường Hồ Chí Minh when the night is the city, not the sand. The statue is 18 m on the 2025 news page. No second height was printed. It stands at Hồ Tùng Mậu and Trường Thi. The 2022 plan closes the loop around it on Friday and Saturday, 19:00–23:30. An English report adds Sunday and names Nguyễn Trãi. A 2026 night list was not opened. No ticket was printed.
getThere: The corner of Hồ Tùng Mậu and Trường Thi, if you sleep by the square.
heroCaption: The statue, head to feet, above the steps of Quảng trường Hồ Chí Minh

notice.title: Bình Minh is the other square
notice.body: Quảng trường Bình Minh is on the sand at Cửa Lò. This square is in town, at Hồ Tùng Mậu and Trường Thi.

body: Walk the city’s largest political and cultural open space. The city page names a parade way, a garden, and a reviewing stand. The statue in these frames is the full figure, head to feet. A 2025 news page prints it at 18 m. No second height was loaded. Do not look for the beach square here.

The evening, when the barriers are up, is the walking loop. VnExpress and Tuổi Trẻ, in April 2022, name Friday and Saturday, 19:00–23:30, on Hồ Tùng Mậu from Cầu Nại to Nguyễn Trung Ngạn (430 m), Nguyễn Văn Cừ from Hồ Tùng Mậu to Lê Hồng Phong (500 m), plus Nguyễn Trung Ngạn and Nguyễn Tài. The loop is about 1.5 km. Hồ Tùng Mậu has the musical fountain and a ví giặm stage. The English report does not print the fountain’s area as a figure the Vietnamese reports use. It prints nearly 1,000 m², adds Sunday, and names Nguyễn Trãi instead of Nguyễn Trung Ngạn and Nguyễn Tài. Both lists stay. A 2026 confirmation of which nights still close was not opened.

Sleep near the square if this night is the point. Sleep on Bình Minh if the day is the swim. The plan runs to 23:30 on the nights it names. What the rest of the city does after that was not printed. Arrive on a weeknight and the barriers may not be there. Confirm the night you go.

figures.caption: The open paving and the full statue. A flagpole stands in front of the figure.
figures.alt: The open lawn of Ho Chi Minh Square in Vinh, with the full statue and a Vietnamese flag

gettingThere: This is the city base if you sleep near the square. The city introduction places it at the corner of Hồ Tùng Mậu and Trường Thi. After 1 July 2025, Trường Thi is one of the old wards folded into phường Trường Vinh. The square does not move. A visit time was not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From a room by the square
legs.body: On foot. Hồ Tùng Mậu and Trường Thi meet at the corner the city page names. A timed walk was not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Cửa Lò
legs.body: The beach distances stay 16 km, 17 km, 18 km, and about 20 km. About 30 minutes by car is only the Núi Cấm figure for the 18 km. The station street was not printed. Check on arrival.

closed: No gate hour for the square was printed. The walking-street plan is Friday and Saturday 19:00–23:30, with Sunday only on the English report. A 2026 night list is check on arrival.
admissionNote: No ticket was printed. Check on arrival. The walking loop’s entry fee was not printed either.
